author: Copilot
Copilot
body: `safe_name` is derived from `fc.filepath` and interpolated into an HTML attribute without escaping. A repo file path can legally contain quotes or other special characters, which can break the generated HTML and can enable XSS in the published report. Sanitize/encode the generated filename (e.g., restrict to `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` or use a hash) and HTML-escape any attribute values.

author: Copilot
body: The per-file report filename uses `safe_name` derived from `fc.filepath` and is used both for writing the output file and as a link target. If `filepath` contains characters like quotes or `..`, this can create invalid filenames/links and (when embedded in HTML elsewhere) XSS risk. Use a strict slug/hash for output filenames and keep the original `filepath` only for display (escaped).

author: Copilot
body:
HTML output is written without an explicit encoding. Since the report includes non-ASCII characters (e.g., emoji/icons), relying on the platform default encoding can produce corrupted output on non-UTF-8 locales. Open the output files with `encoding='utf-8'` (and preferably `newline='\n'`).
```suggestion
    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "index.html"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
```

body:
This script writes HTML containing non-ASCII characters (emoji) but opens the output file without an explicit encoding. ```

author: Copilot
body: The step name/comment says "Checkout gh-pages branch", but the configured ref/publish branch is hard-coded to "PORTAL-0/gh-pages". author: Copilot
body:
Istanbul statement hit counts are being collapsed to 1/0 when building LineCoverage (see hits=1 if >0). That makes the per-line "Nx" gutter misleading and loses useful signal for frequently executed lines; consider storing the real hit count from Istanbul in LineCoverage.hits and only treating >0 as covered for styling.
```suggestion
                        fc.lines.append(LineCoverage(line_number=line_num, hits=line_hits[line_num]))
```

author: Copilot
body:
The filter input/select rely on placeholder text only and have no accessible label. Add a <label> (visually-hidden if desired) or aria-label/aria-labelledby for both controls so screen readers can announce them reliably.
```suggestion
                    <input type="text" id="fileFilter" placeholder="Filter files..." aria-label="Filter files" class="filter-input" oninput="filterTable()">
                    <select id="categoryFilter" aria-label="Filter by category" class="filter-select" onchange="filterTable()">
```

author: Copilot
body:
Sortable table headers are click-only (onclick on <th>) and aren’t keyboard accessible by default. Consider rendering the sort controls as <button> elements inside the headers (or add tabindex=0 + key handlers + appropriate aria-sort) so keyboard and assistive-tech users can sort.
```suggestion
                        <th class="sortable" scope="col">
                            <button type="button" class="sortable-header-button" onclick="sortTable(0)" aria-label="Sort by file">
                                File
                            </button>
                        </th>
                        <th class="text-center sortable" scope="col">
                            <button type="button" class="sortable-header-button" onclick="sortTable(1)" aria-label="Sort by type">
                                Type
                            </button>
                        </th>
                        <th class="sortable" scope="col">
                            <button type="button" class="sortable-header-button" onclick="sortTable(2)" aria-label="Sort by coverage">
                                Coverage
                            </button>
                        </th>
                        <th scope="col">Visual</th>
                        <th class="text-center sortable" scope="col">
                            <button type="button" class="sortable-header-button" onclick="sortTable(4)" aria-label="Sort by statements">
                                Statements
                            </button>
                        </th>
                        <th class="text-center sortable" scope="col">
                            <button type="button" class="sortable-header-button" onclick="sortTable(5)" aria-label="Sort by covered">
                                Covered
                            </button>
                        </th>
                        <th class="text-center sortable" scope="col">
                            <button type="button" class="sortable-header-button" onclick="sortTable(6)" aria-label="Sort by missed">
                                Missed
                            </button>
                        </th>
```

author: Copilot
Copilot
body:
Same scalability concern as PR mode: iterating 1..max_line for every file in main mode can create millions of `LineCoverage` entries across the repo, making the merge-to-main workflow slow or memory-heavy. Consider storing only executed/missing lines and deriving non-instrumentable lines at render time.
```suggestion
        for line_num, hits in sorted(
            [(line_num, 1) for line_num in executed]
            + [(line_num, 0) for line_num in missing]
        ):
            fc.lines.append(LineCoverage(line_number=line_num, hits=hits))
```
